name: Thunder Nova · Death
primary:
An explosion at the aim point with a 4.5-block radius (does not hit you):
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning + 1.25 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 2.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4 s
• Life drain: 0.5 ❤ damage, you heal 0.2 ❤
self_description:
An explosion around you with a 4.5-block radius, hitting you as well:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3 s
